pairs.label: chair and corporate rows first
pairs.old:
Therapeutic Massage

Therapeutic massage gives steady attention to the places where you feel tension, at a pace and pressure that suit you. Tell me where it bothers you and what you would like from the session, and I will adjust as I go.

Deep Tissue Massage

Deep tissue massage uses focused strokes and sustained pressure on areas that stay tight. Deep does not have to mean painful: I check in about pressure throughout, and you decide how firm it gets.

Thai Massage

Thai massage is my specialty. It combines rhythmic compression, gentle rocking, and assisted stretching, and you stay fully clothed. I set the pressure, pace, and range of each stretch by how your body responds, so a session can be restful, more active, or somewhere in between.

Chair Massage

Short, seated massage through your clothing, focused on the back, shoulders, neck, arms and hands: what I bring to employee appreciation days and workplace events, in a portable chair that fits in a quiet corner. Learn about Chair Massage

Corporate & Group Massage

On-site chair massage for employee appreciation days and workplace events, with table massage considered at suitable host venues. Tell me about your team and I will send a quote. Explore Corporate & Group Massage
